name: 63136 · Saint Louis, MO
findings: ZIP 63136 (Saint Louis) has 160 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63136 (Saint Louis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
